execution_stages.name: owner_goal_intake
execution_stages.description: Parse and interpret owner mission for email live readiness assessment.

execution_stages.name: ceo_mission_interpretation
execution_stages.description: CEO defines live email unlock strategy and overall readiness assessment scope.

execution_stages.name: department_briefing
execution_stages.description: COO distributes briefing to all 10 departments, defining roles and artifact expectations.

execution_stages.name: department_artifact_proposals
execution_stages.description: Each department proposes their needed artifacts for readiness assessment.

execution_stages.name: cross_department_negotiation
execution_stages.description: Departments negotiate final artifact list. Sales AI prioritizes use cases. CMO adds tone/brand safety. CTO adds technical readiness.

execution_stages.name: artifact_manifest_creation
execution_stages.description: Final artifact manifest is locked and assigned to workers.

execution_stages.name: worker_assignment
execution_stages.description: Workers assigned to each artifact with clear instructions.

execution_stages.name: artifact_generation
execution_stages.description: All departments generate assigned readiness artifacts — readiness payload, compliance checklist, sender identity rules, consent model, etc.

execution_stages.name: qa_review
execution_stages.description: QA performs safety and compliance audits on all artifacts. Fails if any hard lock is violated.

execution_stages.name: gap_analysis
execution_stages.description: CTO identifies coverage gaps in readiness assessment artifacts.

execution_stages.name: gap_closure
execution_stages.description: Gaps are closed with additional checks or documented as future milestone requirements.

execution_stages.name: final_packaging
execution_stages.description: All deliverables compiled into final package.

execution_stages.name: kpi_scoring
execution_stages.description: CFO compiles KPI scorecard for readiness gate.

execution_stages.name: learning_update
execution_stages.description: CLO Hermes records lessons learned and recommends live email unlock criteria.

execution_stages.name: verification
execution_stages.description: Run full verifier suite and auto-loop for stable 2/2 passes.

execution_stages.name: pr_preparation
execution_stages.description: Prepare PR body with [READY_FOR_AUTO_MERGE] title and wait for owner token.
